Import a Clank World bot

Paste the fields from your Clank World bot. The character prompt is required; everything else is optional. The app works out their name, gender, race, age and schedule, makes them a world from the scene, and opens the creator so you can check everything before saving.

Lorebook entries

One per box. Add the entry's keywords (comma-separated) and its text. They go into the new world's lorebook.

Settings

Account
Your API key is sent only to the AI provider you choose. If you're signed in, it's also saved (encrypted) to your account so your other devices get it. Type demo as the key to try the app without spending anything.
Who you play is set in Personas.
Keep a permanent record of your stories as Markdown notes: one note per character with their memories and relationships, a journal note for every in-app day, and the story so far, all linked so Obsidian's graph shows your cast. It's a record only: the app never reads it back, so editing the notes doesn't change what happened.
